title: Find the rhythm
target: Make room for easy running around football.
adjustment: Keep the week flexible; the first 3 km is logged.

title: Repeat, then build
target: Aim for a repeatable week of comfortable running.
adjustment: Adjust the amount to recovery and football load.

title: Time on feet
target: Consider a little more time on an easy outing if recovered.
adjustment: Distance is optional; consistency is the target.

title: Settle into it
target: Keep most running comfortable and leave room for recovery.
adjustment: Football counts toward the week’s total effort.

title: Check in
target: Review logged effort and how the longer outings feel.
adjustment: Reassess the race target using current training, not old PBs.

title: Keep it sustainable
target: Choose a manageable week based on recent recovery.

title: Make some space
target: Reduce training load and prioritize feeling rested.

title: Arrive fresh
target: Keep any running light and optional before race day.
adjustment: Race result stays unreported until a result is supplied.
